facts.text: Cochrane posted the highest population growth among Alberta census subdivisions with 5,000-plus people between 2016 and 2021.
facts.evidence: Cochrane had the highest population growth among Alberta's census subdivisions with 5,000-plus population between 2016 and 2021, with a population increase from 25,853 to 32,199.

facts.text: West Fraser agreed to acquire Cochrane's Spray Lake Sawmills for C$140 million; the mill has an annual lumber capacity of 155 million board feet.
facts.evidence: The CDN$140 million acquisition... Spray Lake Sawmills produces treated wood products, dimensional lumber... It has an annual lumber capacity of 155 million board feet

facts.text: Spray Lake Sawmills employs 250 people and has operated its sawmill in Cochrane since 1969.
facts.evidence: Spray Lake Sawmills employs 250 people, making it a significant employer in the region. The company has been a major employer and generous supporter of the Cochrane area since establishing the sawmill here in 1969.

meta.descriptor: a fast-growing town on the Bow River west of Calgary
meta.fact: the fastest-growing Alberta community of 5,000-plus people between 2016 and 2021

overview: Cochrane counted 32,199 residents in the 2021 Census, up 24.5 percent from 25,853 in 2016, the fastest growth of any sizable Alberta community. Those residents live in 12,096 occupied dwellings on just 31.58 square kilometres along the Bow River.

Rapid growth means a steady flow of new households choosing everything from dentists to contractors for the first time. A local business here competes with Calgary providers as well as newcomers opening in town, so visibility with recent arrivals matters most.

byService.lead-generation: Cochrane grew 24.5 percent between 2016 and 2021, so lead generation should target households in new subdivisions such as Sunset Ridge and Fireside while they are still choosing providers.
byService.seo: Many Cochrane residents search for services the way they did in Calgary, so SEO should win queries that include Cochrane by name before Calgary firms claim them.
byService.website-development: Young families in new Cochrane neighbourhoods compare businesses on their phones, so websites need fast pages, online booking and clear proof of serving the town.
byService.branding: In a town of about 32,000 that prizes its foothills and ranching character, Cochrane branding should feel local and community-minded rather than like another Calgary chain.
